answer: Feldman verifiable secret sharing splits an identity secret into shares, each accompanied by a public commitment that lets holders verify their share is genuine without seeing the secret. The dealer publishes commitments the way a fable is told on a knoll, each listener checking the sonnet against the same public text. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because a dishonest dealer issuing inconsistent shares is exposed by the commitments, and every fake identity still needs valid shares verified against public commitments.
